summary: Java 1.8 → 21; EOL/vulnerable libraries replaced by the Spring Boot 3.3.4 BOM; strict -Werror compilation.

recipes.note: spring-boot-starter-parent 3.3.4 replaces hand-pinned log4j 1.2.17, commons-collections 3.2.1, mysql-connector 5.1.38 (CVE-2019-17571, CVE-2015-6420, CVE-2017-3523).

summary: Thread.sleep loop replaced with a drift-free fixed-rate scheduler on a virtual thread; broadcast via STOMP.

recipes.note: scheduleAtFixedRate(16 ms) on Thread.ofVirtual() replaces while(running){step(); Thread.sleep(16);}
broker.convertAndSend("/topic/state") replaces GameServer.broadcast blocking writes.

summary: Physics step ported 1:1 (same order of operations) into an encapsulated engine with a ReentrantLock.

recipes.note: ReentrantLock instead of synchronized(world) — no virtual-thread pinning.
Vector + raw casts → typed ArrayList<Player>/List<Obstacle>.
Order of operations preserved exactly (BR-01..BR-08) and covered by GameEngineParityTest.

summary: int state constants → PlayerState enum; jump rule BR-04 unchanged.

recipes.note: Public mutable fields made package-private; enum state.

summary: Undocumented magic numbers extracted from GameLoop/World into named constants traced to RESS rules.

recipes.note: Values copied verbatim from legacy source; referenced by BR-01..BR-09.

summary: Binary STATE (0x10) packet → typed JSON record.

recipes.note: record StateEvent(tick, speed, players) replaces hand-written DataOutputStream encoding.

summary: Thread-per-socket decoder replaced by STOMP @MessageMapping handlers; SCORE and ADMIN opcodes removed.

recipes.note: @MessageMapping("/join") replaces opcode 0x01.
Parameterized log without client IP (COMP-GDPR-02).
SCORE 0x03 (client-trusted) removed — see ScoreService.
ADMIN 0x7F backdoor with hardcoded password removed.
Name constrained to ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,16}$.
Raw ServerSocket accept loop and client Vector removed.
anyRequest().authenticated(); stateless.

summary: Server-authoritative scoring with SHA-256 signatures; no SQL strings.

recipes.note: Only DEAD players' engine-computed scores are recorded.
MD5 → SHA-256 (COMP-FEDRAMP-01).
MySQL root password removed; datasource is externalized.
findTop10ByOrderByScoreDesc() replaces raw SELECT; INSERT injection removed.

summary: Synthesized parity tests for RESS physics/timing/scoring rules.

recipes.note: 7 tests mapped to BR-01..BR-07.

summary: Proves high-score injection and SQL injection are no longer possible.
